verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (logo, sale banner, product, headline, offer, CTA), but the SOLSTICE logo is shoved into the top-right corner, the legal line is set almost as large as the offer copy and crowds the CTA, and the oversized CTA nearly touches the canvas edges. B breaks the reading order: the CTA sits at the very top above the headline, and the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon and a tiny product are pushed to the bottom, so the hero product is reduced to a trivial icon and the brand mark is effectively gone. B also sets the fine print as large as the body copy.
